newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson rises, ignoring Motorola losses.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson rises, ignoring Motorola losses.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson AB posted gains in early trade Thursday after losing some ground on Wednesday in the wake of a poor Motorola report.
Ericsson shares were 2.50 crowns higher at 161.50 within five minutes of trading after falling up to 4.50 crowns on Wednesday.
U.S. rival Motorola Inc on Wednesday announced that weak chip sales and competition in cellular phone sales would hurt its third quarter earnings and its share price fell three percent overnight.
Analysts said they had no plans to downgrade forecasts for Ericsson in the light of Motorola's weak outlook.
Ericsson Microwave System and Saab AB called a press conference for 1300 GMT Thursday to give details about changes in the two companies.
